name: Text Display
author: ChuckBuilds
description: Display custom scrolling or static text with configurable fonts, colors, and scroll speed. Perfect for announcements, messages, or custom displays.

versions.changelog: .bdf fonts render. font_path accepts .bdf, but the plugin loaded one as a bare freetype.Face, which PIL cannot draw or measure with: at the font's own size every frame raised and the panel stayed blank, and at any other size loading failed and the default font was used instead. .bdf files now load through PIL at the pixel size the file declares, the loader clock-simple, countdown and calendar already use. Saving a speed change in the web UI now re-runs the core's scroll resolver, as a restart does. It used to push the old frame-based speed onto the scroll helper, which dropped the resolver's whole-pixel step and kept the previous frame hold, so an edited speed moved differently until the next restart. Removed target_fps: nothing in the core reads the value it set, so it never changed how text moved; a saved config that still has it loads with a schema warning until it is next saved. Requires LEDMatrix core 3.4.0, as before.

Requires LEDMatrix core 3.4.0 or newer, because scrolling text uses the new scroll frame pacing. Since 1.1.8 display() passes frame_hold to display_manager.set_scrolling_state(), an argument core 3.3.x does not have; the call sits inside the try that wraps the whole frame, so on those cores every scrolling frame raised TypeError, logged an error and drew nothing. The manifest still admitted any core from 2.0.0, so the store kept offering it there. The floor is now 3.4.0 (versions[0] and compatible_versions), so the store refuses the install on an older core and asks the user to update LEDMatrix first. A copy already installed on a 3.3.x core stays broken until that core is updated. No code change.
Resolve scroll speed through the shared resolver and apply the frame hold it reports, so slow speeds move whole pixels
Render text 1-bit (no anti-aliasing) so glyphs stay crisp on the LED grid

versions.notes: display_duration is a time value, so preserve fractional seconds (float instead of int) when used as the dynamic-scroll duration floor, and re-apply it on runtime config changes so live edits take effect immediately.

Fix scrolling text never scrolling when scroll_gap_width is stored as a float (the web UI persists the "number" schema type as e.g. 32.0): int-coerce scroll_gap_width on read and guard cache_width before Image.new(), which was crashing every frame. Also honor display_duration as the dynamic-duration floor instead of a hardcoded 10.

Config schema reorganized for a clearer setup experience: fine-tuning fields moved behind the web UI's collapsed Advanced Settings section (x-advanced). UX-only; no fields, defaults, or behavior changed.

Fix font_mode auto rendering visibly antialiased/blurry text on small panels: dropped 5by7.regular (never crisp at any tested size) and corrected 4x6-font from 6px to 7px (its actual crisp native size).
